def call(self, name, group, body, target=0, repeat=0, semantic=False):
        if self.cancel():
            raise RuntimeError("cancelled before request")
        encoded = canonical(body)
        if len(encoded) > MAX_BODY:
            raise ValueError("request body exceeds 8 MiB")
        row = dict(name=name, group=group, target=target, repeat=repeat,
                   status="running", request_sha256=digest(encoded),
                   request_bytes=len(encoded), client_id=BASE_CLIENT,
                   output_budget=body["max_tokens"])
        self.rows.append(row)
        (self.out / (name + ".request.json")).write_bytes(encoded)
        self.save()
        self.mark_phase("prefill", name)
        start = time.perf_counter()
        first = None
        text_parts, reasoning_parts, finishes = [], [], []
        usage, timings, done = None, None, False
        stop_heartbeat = threading.Event()

        def heartbeat():
            while not stop_heartbeat.wait(30):
                print("WAIT %s %.0fs" % (name, time.perf_counter() - start),
                      flush=True)

        threading.Thread(target=heartbeat, daemon=True).start()
        request = urllib.request.Request(
            self.args.base_url.rstrip("/") + "/v1/chat/completions",
            data=encoded, headers={"Content-Type": "application/json",
                                   "Accept": "text/event-stream",
                                   "X-Client-ID": BASE_CLIENT})
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=7200) as response:
                row["http_status"] = response.status
                row["response_headers"] = dict(response.headers.items())
                with (self.out / (name + ".response.sse")).open("wb") as raw:
                    for event in sse_events(response, raw, self.cancel):
                        if event == "[DONE]":
                            done = True
                            break
                        chunk = json.loads(event)
                        if "error" in chunk:
                            raise RuntimeError("SSE error: " +
                                               json.dumps(chunk["error"]))
                        if chunk.get("usage") is not None:
                            usage = chunk["usage"]
                        if chunk.get("timings") is not None:
                            timings = chunk["timings"]
                        for choice in chunk.get("choices", []):
                            delta = choice.get("delta", {})
                            part = delta.get("content")
                            if isinstance(part, str) and part:
                                if first is None:
                                    first = time.perf_counter()
                                    self.mark_phase("decode", name)
                                text_parts.append(part)
                            reason = delta.get("reasoning_content")
                            if isinstance(reason, str) and reason:
                                reasoning_parts.append(reason)
                            if choice.get("finish_reason") is not None:
                                finishes.append(choice["finish_reason"])
            row["wall_s"] = time.perf_counter() - start
            row["ttft_ms"] = (first - start) * 1000 if first is not None else None
            row["usage"], row["timings"] = usage, timings
            row["finish_reasons"] = finishes
            if not done or not finishes or usage is None or timings is None:
                raise ValueError("incomplete SSE response or missing metrics")
            if first is None or reasoning_parts:
                raise ValueError("missing visible content or unexpected reasoning")
            row.update(extract_metrics(usage, timings, self.args.mode,
                                       not body["cache_prompt"]))
            if row["output_tokens"] > body["max_tokens"]:
                raise ValueError("output exceeded requested max_tokens")
            row["output_condition"] = "budget_reached" if row["output_tokens"] == body["max_tokens"] else "short_output"
            if row["input_tokens"] + row["output_tokens"] > self.result["context"]:
                raise ValueError("input plus output exceeds actual reported context")
            row["semantic_pass"] = semantic_ok("".join(text_parts)) if semantic else None
            if semantic and not row["semantic_pass"]:
                raise ValueError("three-code retrieval check failed")
            row["status"] = "ok"
            return row
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
            error_body = error.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
            row.update(status="error", http_status=error.code, error=error_body)
            (self.out / (name + ".http-error.txt")).write_text(
                error_body, encoding="utf-8")
            raise HttpFailure(error.code, error_body) from error
        except Exception as error:
            row.update(status="error", error=str(error))
            raise
        finally:
            stop_heartbeat.set()
            self.mark_phase("idle", name)
            row["wall_s"] = time.perf_counter() - start
            reply = "".join(text_parts)
            row["reply_sha256"] = digest(reply.encode("utf-8"))
            row["visible_characters"] = len(reply)
            (self.out / (name + ".reply.txt")).write_text(reply, encoding="utf-8")
            (self.out / (name + ".reasoning.txt")).write_text(
                "".join(reasoning_parts), encoding="utf-8")

for row in mtp["rows"]:
        if row["status"] != "ok" or row["group"] in ("calibration", "warmup"):
            continue
        prior = ar_rows.get(row["name"])
        if row["group"] == "capacity":
            candidates = [r for r in ar_rows.values() if r["group"] == "capacity"
                          and r["target"] == row["target"] and r.get("count_pass")]
            prior = candidates[-1] if candidates else None
        same = (prior is not None
                and prior["request_sha256"] == row["request_sha256"]
                and prior.get("client_id") == row.get("client_id"))
        required = row["group"] in ("cold", "capacity")
        if required and not same:
            raise ValueError("required comparison payload differs: " + row["name"])
        pair = dict(name=row["name"], group=row["group"], target=row["target"],
                    comparable=same, reply_matches=None,
                    ar_output_tokens=prior.get("output_tokens") if prior else None,
                    mtp_output_tokens=row.get("output_tokens"),
                    decode_comparable=same and prior.get("output_tokens") == row.get("output_tokens"),
                    ar_tg=None, mtp_tg=row.get("tg_tok_s"), tg_change_pct=None,
                    ar_pp=None, mtp_pp=row.get("pp_tok_s"), pp_change_pct=None,
                    ar_ttft_ms=None, mtp_ttft_ms=row.get("ttft_ms"),
                    mtp_accepted=row.get("draft_accepted"),
                    mtp_proposed=row.get("draft_proposed"),
                    ar_cached=prior.get("cached_tokens") if prior else None,
                    mtp_cached=row.get("cached_tokens"))
        if same:
            pair["reply_matches"] = prior["reply_sha256"] == row["reply_sha256"]
            pair["ar_ttft_ms"] = prior["ttft_ms"]
            for short, key in (("tg", "tg_tok_s"), ("pp", "pp_tok_s")):
                pair["ar_" + short] = prior[key]
                if prior[key] and row[key] is not None and (short != "tg" or pair["decode_comparable"]):
                    pair[short + "_change_pct"] = (row[key] / prior[key] - 1) * 100
            if not pair["reply_matches"]:
                warnings.append("Visible output differs: " + row["name"])
        else:
            warnings.append("Conversation input differs; do not compare speed: " +
                            row["name"])
        pairs.append(pair)
    cold_summary = []
